description: Polish voivodeship letters (Załącznik nr 13, col. 4), including the second letters (D/V, K/J, W/A, R/Y, G/X, S/I, P/M) that § 31 ust. 3 brings into use after the first letter's capacity is exhausted. Used alone as the prefix of reduced-size (§ 30 ust. 2 pkt 2), temporary (pkt 6), diplomatic (pkt 7) and individual (pkt 4) plates.
